THE FRIENDLY NEIGHBORHOOD HANDBOOK

Learn the ropes.
And the webs.

01Find your feet

Use ← → or A / D to move. On your phone, hold the arrow buttons.

02Take a leap

Press Space, W or ↑ to jump. Tap again in the air for a double jump.

03Get in the swing

Hold X or SWING to attach a web overhead. Steer to build momentum, then release to launch. You can attach again midair.

04Keep it friendly

Press C or WEB to fire at drones and the Goblin. Get close to stranded citizens to rescue them. Follow the rooftop beacon when your objective is complete.

Progress saves on this browser. P or Escape pauses. Sound is optional. You can replay any unlocked chapter.
